The '''Morai''' is a sept of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. 

==Activities==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] is planning his siege on [[Malden]] he hears of two large groups of Aiel on their way to the city.{{ref/book|11|26}} Those groups are the Morai and the [[White Cliff]] septs.{{ref/book|11|5}} [[Gueye Arabah]] later reports that the two septs will arrive at Malden at noon.{{ref/book|11|29}} After the [[Battle of Malden]], the two septs are still a few hours from the city.{{ref/book|11|30}}
